integrity: The proof is symbolic. Exhaustive checks on the actual matrix graphs over F_2 and F_3 and on the projective support model for q=2,3,4,5 are included only as corroboration.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to full 2-by-2 matrix rings over finite fields.
No claim is made for higher matrix dimension or matrix rings over nonfields.
An unindexed source using the undirected noncommutative zero-divisor convention could contain the same formula.
title: Domination of the underlying zero-divisor graph of \(M_2(\mathbb F_q)\)
